description: Water actively flooding from a burst pipe — needs someone today, not troubleshooting.

caller.opening: Water is pouring out from under my kitchen sink, it's flooding the floor right now!
caller.persona: Jess, panicking slightly, water still running. Does not know where the shut-off valve is.

facts.name: Jess
facts.problem: a burst pipe under the kitchen sink, flooding the floor right now

caller.goal: get the water stopped and someone out today. You do not know where the shut off valve is.
